DELETE from [dbo].[tbl_FCM_GMI_Fee_Recon_ST4] 
WHERE MONTH(create_Dte) = MONTH(GETDATE())
AND YEAR(create_Dte) = YEAR(GETDATE())

SELECT  cast(COUNT(*) as int) as ActualRowsLoaded
from dbo.tbl_FCM_GMI_Fee_Recon_ST4
where cast(create_dte as date) = cast(getdate() as date)

DELETE FROM  [dbo].[tbl_FCM_GMI_Fee_Recon_GL] 
WHERE MONTH(create_Dte) = MONTH(GETDATE())
AND YEAR(create_Dte) = YEAR(GETDATE())

SELECT  cast(COUNT(*) as int) as ActualRowsLoaded
from dbo.tbl_FCM_GMI_Fee_Recon_GL
where cast(create_dte as date) = cast(getdate() as date)

SELECT MAX(cast(effDate as date)) as BusinessDay FROM [kpikriReporting].[dbo].[tbl_lvlThreeDetail_GL]
where effDate > cast(DATEADD(m,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,getdate()), 0)) as date)

DELETE  FROM  [ReconControl].dbo.tbl_FCM_GMI_Fee_Recon_Intellimatch
 WHERE MONTH(create_dt) = MONTH(GETDATE())
AND YEAR(create_Dt) = YEAR(GETDATE())

SELECT  cast(COUNT(*) as int) as ActualRowsLoaded
from dbo.tbl_FCM_GMI_Fee_Recon_Intellimatch
where cast(create_dt as date) = cast(getdate() as date)

select  [itemId], [effDate], riskMonth, [rc],[co], [dda], [subAccount],[name1],[description],[balancePool], [entryDate],[riskDate],[currency],[dr] ,[cr],[amount],[amtOrig], [create_dt]
 from [kpikriReporting].[dbo].[tbl_lvlThreeDetail_GL]
 where rc in ('0010842', '0150279', '0150303', '0166333', '0168269', '0198086', '0162277', '0119858', '0210171') 
and dda = '4402882'
and co = '00037' 
and entryDate >= (cast(DATEADD(m,-1,DATEADD(mm, DATEDIFF(m,0,getdate()), 0)) as date)) and 
(entryDate < cast (Dateadd(dd, -Datepart(dd, Getdate()) + 1, Getdate()) as DATE)) and 
cast(effDate as date) = cast('6/5/2017' as date)

sMsgFailINT.defaultValue: Process failed loading Intellimatch for EOM

sCommentST4.defaultValue: Start Loading ST4 for FCM GMI Fee Recon - Step 1 of 3

sSQLCmdST4EOM_A.defaultValue:
Select effDate, PACCT, PATFE1, PATFE2,  PATFE4,  PCALC, PCLASS, PCMNT1, PCTYM,  PEXCH, PFC, PGIVF,  PGIVIO, POFFIC, PRECID, PSDSC1, PSNAME, PSPRED, PSTYPE, PSUBCL, PSUBTY, PTTYPE, PTYPE, PUSER, PTDATE, PFIRM, 
case when PEXCH in ('7B', '9B') then '0198086' else 'NA' end as AU_Number, sum(PTPRIC) as PTPRIC, sum(PFEE1) as PFEE1, sum(PFEE2) as PFEE2, sum(PFEE4) as PFEE4, sum(PFEE1 + PFEE2 + PFEE4) as total_fee, sum(PQTY) as PQTY from vStaging_LoadGMI_ST4F1History 
where PRECID in ('A', 'B', 'E', 'T', 'V', 'X')  
and PFIRM in ('B','D')
and  PEXCH in ('7B', '9B' ) and PSUBCL not in ('D') and PCLASS in ('C', 'H', 'Z') and effDate   >=  convert (varchar(10), '2/1/2025', 102) and effDate < convert(varchar(10), '3/1/2025' , 102)
 group by 
 effDate,  PACCT, PATFE1, PATFE2, PATFE4, PCALC, PCLASS, PCMNT1, PCTYM, PEXCH, PFC, PGIVF, PGIVIO, POFFIC, 
 PRECID, PSDSC1, PSNAME, PSPRED, PSTYPE, PSUBCL, PSUBTY, PTTYPE, PTYPE, PUSER, PTDATE, PFIRM, 
 case when PEXCH in ('7B', '9B') then '0198086' else 'NA' end

sSQLCmdST4EOM_B.defaultValue:
Select effDate, PACCT, PATFE1, PATFE2, PATFE4, PCALC, PCLASS, PCMNT1, PCTYM,  PEXCH, PFC, PGIVF,  PGIVIO, POFFIC, PRECID, PSDSC1, PSNAME, PSPRED, PSTYPE, PSUBCL, PSUBTY, PTTYPE, PTYPE, PUSER, PTDATE, PFIRM, case when PEXCH in ('8U') then '0162277' when PEXCH in ('C0') then '0210171' when PEXCH in ('U0') then '0119858' 
when PEXCH in ('5B', '5C', '5D') then '0168269' when PEXCH in ('09') then '0166333' when PEXCH in ('05', '5K', '7K', '7G','14','19') then '0150303' when PEXCH in ('06', '13') then '0150279' when PEXCH in ('01', '02', '04','07','16', '9C') then '0010842' else 'NA' end as AU_Number, sum(PTPRIC) as PTPRIC, sum(PFEE1) as PFEE1, sum(PFEE2) as PFEE2, sum(PFEE4) as PFEE4, sum(PFEE1 + PFEE2 + PFEE4 ) as total_fee, sum(PQTY) as PQTY from vStaging_LoadGMI_ST4F1History 
where PRECID in ('A', 'B', 'E', 'T', 'V', 'X')  
and  PEXCH in ('8U', 'U0', 'C0', '5B', '5C', '5D', '09', '05', '5K', '7K', '7G','14','19', '06', '13', '01', '02', '04','07','16', '9C') 
and PSUBCL = 'D' and PCLASS = 'F'  
and Pfirm = 'B' and effDate   >=  convert (varchar(10), '2/1/2025', 102) and effDate < convert(varchar(10), '3/1/2025' , 102) group by effDate,  PACCT, PATFE1, PATFE2, PATFE4, PCALC, PCLASS, PCMNT1, PCTYM, PEXCH, PFC, PGIVF, PGIVIO, POFFIC, PRECID, PSDSC1, PSNAME, PSPRED, PSTYPE, PSUBCL, PSUBTY, PTTYPE, PTYPE, PUSER, PTDATE, PFIRM, case when PEXCH in ('8U') then '0162277' when PEXCH in ('C0') then '0210171' when PEXCH in ('U0') then '0119858'  when PEXCH in ('5B', '5C', '5D') then '0168269' when PEXCH in ('09') then '0166333' when PEXCH in ('05', '5K', '7K', '7G','14','19') then '0150303' when PEXCH in ('06', '13') then '0150279'  when PEXCH in ('01', '02', '04','07','16', '9C') then '0010842' else 'NA' end  having sum(PFEE1+PFEE2+PFEE4) <> 0 union Select effDate, PACCT, PATFE1, PATFE2, PATFE4, PCALC, PCLASS, PCMNT1, PCTYM,  PEXCH, PFC, PGIVF,  PGIVIO, POFFIC, PRECID, PSDSC1, PSNAME, PSPRED, PSTYPE, PSUBCL, PSUBTY, PTTYPE, PTYPE, PUSER, PTDATE, PFIRM, case when PEXCH in ('01', '04','07') then '0010842' when PEXCH in ('06', '13') then '0150279' when PEXCH in ('05', '5K', '7K', '7G','14','19') then '0150303' when PEXCH in ('09') then '0166333' when PEXCH in ('5B', '5C', '5D') then '0168269'  else 'NA' end as AU_Number, sum(PTPRIC) as PTPRIC, sum(PFEE1) as PFEE1, sum(PFEE2) as PFEE2, sum(PFEE4) as PFEE4, sum(PFEE1 + PFEE2 + PFEE4) as total_fee, sum(PQTY) as PQTY from vStaging_LoadGMI_ST4F1History
